summary: A quick model beside her model. New workbench/quick_model.py: a second sealed runtime in its own slot (brain.quick_worker), launched as a brain.activate job with the new launch option slot 'quick' through the same start (file hash, memory rule, seal check, its own private socket), never a handover; it keeps its own primed prompts (brain.quick_kept). A quick kind (READ, PLAN, NEXT, MARKS, ASK) goes to it only when offered, its A5 exam record on the quick model's own key says EXAMINED, and her clock prices the kind's typical question lower on its key with both keys measured; otherwise her model keeps it, with the reason in words. turns.request_for builds the routes once per request and ask() takes request.port_for(kind), so the price, the record's key and model and her line ('Asking the quick model') are the answering model's. The memory sum counts both (resource_control._view; the quick cap fitted beside her model's budget and the reserve); when both do not fit it is not loaded and the Brain room says why with the numbers. One Undo puts every kind back on her model. The Brain room has a 'Quick model' page; her column's model line adds 'quick: <kinds>'. The model check gained stage SQ (--quick FILE): both measured on her typical question, the quick model's exam for the quick kinds, and the split proposed with Use it and Undo. Live here (4B as her model, 2B as the quick one, both sealed, side by side): the 2B was about twice as fast on her typical question (6.9 s against 14.8 s on this shared CPU) but failed its exams (READ 3 harmful, ASK 9 of 20, NEXT 14 of 20), so it took no kind and every turn stayed on the 4B; the positive path (a passed and faster kind routed to the quick model, her line, Undo) was shown with stand-in workers. Nothing was tested in the owner's sense and nothing ran on the ThinkPad; the speeds here mean nothing for it.

decisions: The quick model is launched as a brain.activate job with a new launch option slot "quick" (not a new job tool): approval, freezing, admission, Cancel and the job runner are reused; resource_control.request gives it no handover and freeze_launch no credit for her model's memory.

Passing an exam = A5's EXAMINED on the quick model's own key (19 of the last 20 right, harm 0). In the pair stage each quick kind sits at most 24 items, taken in turn from every paper that asks it (NEXT from CHOOSE and STEER), and a kind with fewer than 20 items (ASK, 11) sits them twice; an answer that changes is A5's CHANGED.

Measured faster = her clock's price of the kind's typical question (TYPICAL: brain_clock.BUDGETS' typical sizes, PLAN 120 new / 48 written) lower on the quick key, only when both keys have rates of their own (the pair measurement through runtime_tuning.remember, or three turns each); the stand-in rates never count.

Every quick kind is offered once a quick model loads; Undo offers none (the earlier offer kept); "Offer the quick kinds again" restores it. The model check's proposal sets exactly the kinds it found passed and faster; its Undo restores the offer before.
PLAN has no exam paper, so it always stays on her model until a paper exists.

The quick model answers only beside her model: it takes her model's context, threads and backend unless asked; with her model stopped nothing goes to it; Stop brain (and closing the window) stops both; loading another model of hers keeps it.

The quick model's memory cap = its rung's estimate + max(2,048 MiB, half of it), because on the processor the guard caps address space (RLIMIT_AS) and the address space runs about 930 MiB over the estimate at Ready (measured); local_brain.configuration now takes the rung whose estimate and slack fit a quick cap, so cap and rung agree.
Forget: a quick model that may hold the forgotten turn is stopped at once and loaded again only by the owner (no automatic restart, unlike her model's).
Her column's model line stays short ("Qwen3.5 4B · quick: NEXT"); the Brain room names the quick model and gives each reason.

The model check's stage SQ runs after S5 and only with --quick (the Brain room passes the quick model it has); its exam results and both rates reach this computer's record only through the Brain room (keep_pair), as A5's exam results do.
A quick model that stops by itself is said in the Brain room with what its runtime log says, so a missing quick model is never silent.
findings_for_the_coordinator: On the processor the worker guard caps address space (RLIMIT_AS = memory_mb) and llama-server b12359 runs well past the memory sum's estimate: the 4B at 5,407 MiB at Ready against its 4,669 MiB estimate (peak 5,714 under a 6,144 cap after the exam), the 2B 3,012 at Ready against 2,334 for its small rung. Auto's 65 % budget hides it; an owner's host budget near the estimate (A5 used 5,120 for the 4B) can end in std::bad_alloc as M1's larger prompt cache fills. The quick model has slack of its own; her model's explicit caps do not.

M1's tuning stage remembers its measured rates inside the model check's throwaway profile (Work sets ARC1_WORKBENCH_CONFIG_HOME), which is removed at the end, so her clock never sees S2T's rates in the owner's profile. M2 carries the pair's rates out in quick_pair.local.json and keeps them from the Brain room (keep_pair); S2T's could go the same way.
Closing the window stops the brain (qt_app closeEvent dispatches brain.stop): a frames process that opens the same workspace must not close its window while models run.

The 2B failed READ (3 harmful), ASK (9 of 20, late at 6 s on this CPU) and NEXT (14 of 20; CHOOSE 12 of 12, STEER 6 of 12) here, so the live acceptance shows the rule keeping every kind on the 4B; the routed path was shown with stand-ins only. On the ThinkPad the 35B and a small model sit their own exams on their own keys.
brain_briefs.forgotten still marks her model's worker for every forgotten turn, including one the quick model answered (conservative, unchanged).

release_note: A quick model beside hers. You can load a second, small model beside her model (Brain room, Quick model). It answers the quick kinds of question (reading your requests, planning, choosing the next step, reading pages, finding the line that answers) only after it has passed its exam for that kind on your computer and is measured faster there; her model keeps everything else. The Brain room shows, kind by kind, which model answers and why, with her clock's time on each, and one Undo puts every kind back on her model. Both models are sealed the same way and counted together in memory; when both do not fit, the small one is not loaded and the room says why, with the numbers. The model check can measure the pair and propose the split (Use it, with Undo).
